2608.19741.title: One Success Isn't Reliability: Thinkingbox, a Sandbox and Benchmark for Agents in Stateful Business Workflows
2608.19741.paper_summary: Recent agent benchmarks increasingly ground evaluation in executable environments, from code repair to web navigation, app APIs, and function calling. Yet completing consequential work beyond code requires more than producing a plausible response or valid tool call: agents must gather missing information over multiple turns, follow domain policies, coordinate dependent tools, and realize the correct persistent state transition without collateral effects. In this paper, we introduce Thinkingbox, a sandbox for tool-agent-user interaction that provides isolated MCP-compatible tool sessions, complete execution traces, and outcome evaluation over terminal backend state. Built on this sandbox, Thinkingbox-bench contains 507 policy-conditioned workflows across numerous scenarios, including retail, hospitality, auto insurance, neobank internal IT, and consulting IT/HR support. Each attempt is evaluated by task-specific executable checks that accept valid trajectories while rejecting wrong, missing, or extra effects; designated tasks additionally check required properties of the final response. Across proprietary and open-weight models, the strongest achieves 65.36% pass@1, but only 25.25% pass^20. Moreover, many failed trials show clean termination and valid state-changing actions, showing that response or tool-call-level signals are not clear proxies for end-to-end task completion. Thinkingbox-bench reveals a large gap between occasionally finding a successful trajectory and reliably completing stateful business tasks. We release both Thinkingbox and Thinkingbox-Bench: https://github.com/microsoft/thinkingbox
2608.19741.paper_summary_zh: 最近的代理基準測試越來越多地將評估置於可執行環境中，從代碼修復到網頁導航、應用程序API和函數調用。然而，完成超越代碼的重大工作需要的不僅僅是產生一個合理的響應或有效的工具調用：代理必須在多輪中收集缺失的信息，遵循領域政策，協調依賴的工具，並實現正確的持久狀態轉換而不產生附帶影響。在本文中，我們介紹了Thinkingbox，一個用於工具-代理-用戶互動的沙盒，提供隔離的MCP兼容工具會話、完整的執行痕跡和終端後端狀態的結果評估。基於這個沙盒，Thinkingbox-bench包含507個基於政策的工作流程，涵蓋了多種場景，包括零售、酒店、汽車保險、數字銀行內部IT和諮詢IT/人力資源支持。每次嘗試都通過特定任務的可執行檢查進行評估，這些檢查接受有效的軌跡，同時拒絕錯誤、缺失或多餘的影響；指定的任務還檢查最終響應的必要屬性。在專有和開放權重模型中，最強的模型達到65.36%的pass@1，但只有25.25%的pass^20。此外，許多失敗的試驗顯示出乾淨的終止和有效的狀態變更行動，顯示響應或工具調用級別的信號並不是端到端任務完成的明確代理。Thinkingbox-bench揭示了偶爾找到成功軌跡與可靠完成有狀態商業任務之間的巨大差距。我們發布了Thinkingbox和Thinkingbox-Bench：https://github.com/microsoft/thinkingbox
